study_identification_part.si_4_title: Contrasting Case-Control and Normative Reference Approaches to Capture Clinically Relevant Structural Brain Abnormalities in Patients With First-Episode Psychosis Who Are Antipsychotic Naive

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Pre-trained normative reference model (n = 58 836) from Predictive Clinical Neuroscience/brain charts toolkits; single-site University of Alabama at Birmingham cohort including FEP patients and healthy controls (92 HCs) used for calibration and case-control analyses.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "...based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits... We used control data to calibrate normative curves."; "Volumes and deviations were quantified in 98 patients with FEP, and data from 92 controls were used as comparison for case-control contrasts and reference curve calibration."

answer.None (Pre-Trained NM): normative reference model used to compute deviations

answer.SINGLE-SITE: local UAB cohort used for case-control contrasts and calibration (controls) and FEP patient analyses

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative deviations computed from a pre-trained reference model; local healthy controls used to calibrate curves and for case-control contrasts; FEP patients analyzed against normative deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We quantified individual deviations... based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836)..."; "We used control data to calibrate normative curves."; "Volumes and deviations were quantified in 98 patients with FEP, and data from 92 controls were used as comparison for case-control contrasts and reference curve calibration."
